title: psoralea mexicana
intro: Psoralea mexicana, commonly known as "wolf's clover" or "Mexican psoralea", is a plant species belonging to the legume family Fabaceae. It is valued for its diverse health benefits, which include enhancing bone density, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea mexicana involve stimulating the thyroid gland, improving skin conditions, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, alkaloids, and isoflavones, which contribute to its pharmacological activities.
